# Sopplayer

> A lightweight, accessible HTML5 video player with zero runtime dependencies.

## Website
- https://sh20raj-backup.github.io/Sopplayer/
- https://sh20raj-backup.github.io/Sopplayer/docs/
- https://sh20raj-backup.github.io/Sopplayer/demo/
- https://sh20raj-backup.github.io/Sopplayer/players/
- https://sh20raj-backup.github.io/Sopplayer/v1/

## Source
- https://github.com/sh20raj-backup/Sopplayer

## Capabilities
- Native HTML5 video element integration
- Responsive controls
- Keyboard shortcuts
- Captions and WebVTT
- Fullscreen and Picture-in-Picture
- Eight CSS themes, including duolingo
- Video.js-shaped V1 compatibility adapter
- CDN, npm, ES module, React/Next.js and Vue patterns
